title: Tickets settings pages for Shelter and Pet Care
summary: APES Shelter and Rescue and APES Pet Care Clinic now have their own Tickets settings page, where admins can edit the service areas people choose when opening a ticket.
changes: Add a Tickets settings page for APES Shelter and Rescue and for APES Pet Care Clinic.
Admins can add, rename, reorder, archive and restore their service areas, and reset them to the defaults.
Ticket forms, ticket pages and the public Open a ticket page use the edited names.
version_rationale: Patch: extends the managed lists from 0.48.0 to two more modules, seeded from today's areas, with no schema change.
validation: New feature test for both settings pages, adding, renaming and archiving areas, reset and the public page.
Ticket, plugin settings, managed list, admin route denial and architecture tests.
known_limitations: Shelter and Pet Care service areas have no subcategories.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The forms return to the built-in areas; stored settings are ignored.
provenance: Milestone v0.48.3 Beta, issue #472 under epic #470, pull request #599.
